The file references a whole Frankie parts folder (Frankie-arm/Frankie- arms.fla, Frankie-leg/frankie- legs.fla, frankie hands.fla, frankie big happy mouths.fla, frankie-34-back-head.fla, to do/frankie-mouth-34-2.fla) and the shared 'SHAWN'S DON'T TOUCH' reuse folder — the turnaround is the hub of a part-library system.
